title: Hetu (2)
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Tatra || voca || || 3 Rūpam bhikkhave dukkhaṃ || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo rūpassa uppādāya so pi dukkho || dukkhasambhūtam bhikkhave rūpaṃ kuto sukham bhavissati || || 4 Vedanā dukkhā || pe || 5 Saññā dukkhā || || 6 Saṅkhārā dukkhā || || [page 024] 24 KHANDA-SAṂYUTTA [XXII. 19. 7 7 Viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo viññāṇassa uppādāya so pi dukkho || dukkhasambhūtam bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ kuto sukham bhavissati || || 8 Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
